--- a/fde_capsule/fleet_recall_inject.py
+++ b/fde_capsule/fleet_recall_inject.py
@@ -76,10 +76,15 @@ def prepare_writeback(reward: Any, agent_id: str, task_family: Optional[str],
     if not (task_family and str(task_family).strip()):
         return None
     if not (reason and str(reason).strip()):
         return None
+    # W1:规范化 agent_id — daemon 真实 id 含 '-' 且无 'ag_' 前缀(
+    # e.g. "nautilus-prime-001")·落 fleet memory 前必须加 'ag_' 前缀并把
+    # '-' 替成 '_'·保证 fleet memory 主键一致且与 compass ID 口径对齐。
+    if agent_id is not None:
+        normalized = str(agent_id).strip().replace("-", "_")
+        if normalized and not normalized.startswith("ag_"):
+            normalized = "ag_" + normalized
+        agent_id = normalized
     return {
         "agent_id": agent_id,
         "task_family": str(task_family).strip(),
         "reason": str(reason).strip()[:200],
         "task_uid": task_uid,
     }
